headline: 今日电影零上映，剧集《死神》《母狮》霸榜
headlineEn: Zero movie releases today; 'Bleach' and 'Lioness' dominate charts
summary: 今日0部新片上映，电影热度由《怒之杀》领跑；剧集《死神》登顶，《特别行动：母狮》紧随其后，本周4部新片待映，《最后的日出》已排期。
summaryEn: No new movies today; 'Rage Kill' leads movie buzz, while TV top spot goes to 'Bleach' followed by 'Special Ops: Lioness'. Four new films arrive this week; 'The Last Sunrise' is upcoming.

industryHighlights.en: 4 new movies are released this week
'Rage Kill' tops today's movie trending chart

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》领跑本周剧集热度
industryHighlights.en: 'Green Lantern Corps' leads this week's TV trending
